Class MarkdownViewState

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.markdown.MarkdownViewState
public final class MarkdownViewState extends Object
State for a MarkdownView widget, managing scroll position and content dimensions.

During rendering, the state records the total content rows and the visible viewport height, and clamps the scroll offset so callers cannot scroll past the bounds of the document.

Example usage: 

MarkdownViewState state = new MarkdownViewState();

// In event handling:
state.scrollDown();
state.scrollUp();

// In render:
frame.renderStatefulWidget(markdownView, area, state);
